SAYANJALI-BLOCKCHAIN

SAYANJALI BLOCKCHAIN is an independently engineered Layer-1 blockchain infrastructure built in Python, combining deterministic Proof-of-Work consensus, native SYJ monetary accounting, cryptographic wallets and transactions, persistent chain storage, authenticated peer-to-peer networking, synchronization, propagation, and scalable multi-node testnet
